hero.subtitle: OpenSourceMate analyzes your repositories, extracts technical skills, estimates proficiency, and matches you with beginner-friendly issues tailored to your exact developer profile.

howItWorks.title: How OpenSourceMate Works
howItWorks.subtitle: A three-stage intelligent pipeline that bridges your existing coding experience with real open-source contribution opportunities.

step1.title: Analyze GitHub Repositories
step1.desc: Fetches public repositories, detects languages, dependencies (package.json, requirements.txt, pyproject.toml), and repository topics.

step2.title: Extract & Weight Skills
step2.desc: Filters noise languages (Dockerfiles, Makefiles, Jupyter), consolidates ecosystems, and calculates recency-based proficiency.

step3.title: Discover Matched Issues
step3.desc: Scores open issues using TF-IDF term weighting and semantic similarity, surfacing good-first-issues that align with your stack.
